Run your email from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor

Add SendLit's MCP server to your assistant, sign in, and just ask. Your emails still go out through your own provider.

Sign in with OAuth, pick your team and approve what the assistant may read or change. Included on every plan, including Free. MCP covers the work you do day to day; billing, organization setup and team provisioning stay in the dashboard and REST API.

settings.title: Pay for the emails you send, not the size of your list
settings.description: 100,000 subscribers emailed weekly is about 400,000 emails, roughly $40 a month on Amazon SES. List-priced newsletter tools charge hundreds for the same sends.

settings.content:

settings.title: Everything you need to send, nothing you don't

items.title: Broadcasts
items.description: Write in a visual editor and send newsletters and campaigns to your whole list or a segment.

items.title: Sequences
items.description: Welcome series, onboarding and drips that run on their own.

items.title: Transactional email
items.description: Receipts, resets and alerts from one REST API, with the same templates and tracking.

items.title: Your own sender
items.description: Bring Amazon SES or any SMTP provider. Your reputation and your rates stay yours.

items.title: Built for AI agents
items.description: An MCP server lets Claude, Cursor and other assistants manage contacts, templates and sends.

items.title: Open source
items.description: The core is open source and self-hostable, so you're never locked in.

settings.title: Your own SES, without the deliverability homework
settings.description: Moving to Amazon SES usually means wiring up bounces, complaints and suppression yourself. SendLit does it for you.

items.title: Bounces and complaints, handled
items.description: Connect your SES notifications and SendLit records hard bounces and spam complaints automatically.

items.title: Automatic suppression
items.description: Bounced and complaining addresses are suppressed, so you never mail them again and your reputation stays clean.

items.title: One-click unsubscribe
items.description: Every marketing email carries the List-Unsubscribe headers Gmail and Yahoo require (RFC 8058).
